title: SP Gatchalian calls for probe into VisMin power situation amid another Yellow Alert
summary: The NGCP declared the yellow alert for 4 p.m. to 8 p.m. on Sept. 21 after available capacity dropped to 2,500 megawatts against a peak demand of 2,426 MW.
